params.body:
## Why

Shane called the Transport settings tab messy, and looking at the neighbouring panes found two more things: the Save button stands far from the fields it saves on every pane (worst on Achtergrond), and the Achtergrond pane itself wastes its right half while the delete button floats inside the picture. Separately, the VWE password box is empty whether or not a password is set, so the screen cannot tell you which.

Behaviour is unchanged throughout: same fields, same names, same routes, same modals, same JS hooks.

## What

### Transport pane — one section rhythm

Every section now uses the same heading component and spacing that PR 248 gave "Prijzen per land": conditions, **Instellingen** (new heading — the margin/express/transfer-report amounts had none and read as a tail of the conditions above), Prijzen per land, Afmetingen per voertuigklasse, Pick-up adressen, Leveradressen.

### Transport pane — dimension matrix

Plain `ui-list ui-list--compact`: no grey filled header cells, no grey first column, first column in the normal weight, "Lengte" beside the three height bands under a "Hoogte" group label. Class labels are untouched.

The rows now open with a `<td>` instead of a `<th>`. That was a real bug, not just styling: the phone card mode treats a `tbody` row starting with a `<th>` as a *filter row*, so under 768px the matrix collapsed into a grey block of bands followed by unlabelled class names — you could not tell which band a class belonged to. Each cell now carries its band as `data-label`, so a length becomes a card with named rows. (The layout script that copies `thead` labels skips this table — two head cells against four row cells — so the explicit attributes survive.)

### Transport pane — addresses

Heading plus a text button **"Adres toevoegen"** on the same row, instead of a lone floating "+" icon. New `ui-subsection--row` modifier keeps the heading's rule whole while carrying the action, so these sections match the ones without an action exactly. Tables stay `ui-list` with the same row actions; card mode under 768px checked.

### Save row — shared, every pane

Every settings pane already had an in-flow `ui-form-actions` (nothing was `fixed` or `sticky`). The stranded look came from geometry: the form is at most ~960px wide while the pane is the full page, so a right-aligned Save ends up far right of its own fields. A hairline the width of the pane now anchors it — one rule, `.ui-settings-panes .ui-form-actions`, so it lands the same way on transport, showroom, website, ai, vwe, support, achtergrond and the rest.

### Achtergrond pane

- The API key is one field in one column at the top; it used to share a two-column grid with the two images, which left it alone in a narrow left column with the area under it empty.
- The two backgrounds are a pair of equal cards side by side, label above the image.
- The delete is a normal button under the picture instead of floating in its bottom-right corner. The cause was `resources/sass/settings/_settings_background.scss`, which absolutely positioned the button and gave the frame a `28.125vw` height. That partial is used by nothing else, so it is removed and the blade owns the layout.
- **Deleting a background now asks first** (`ui.confirm`). It was the one destructive action on this screen without a question; the attachment beside it has asked one since the ui vocabulary landed.

The remove script is untouched, and the markup keeps what it depends on: the button stays a direct child of the element carrying `class="background_image"` and `id="background_image_…"`, because the handler reads the id from the button's parent.

### Write-only secrets

Audited every settings pane. **`vwe_password` is the only genuine write-only secret**, and it is the only field that got the hint:

| field | verdict |
| --- | --- |
| `vwe_password` (vwe) | **hint added** — encrypted on save, `value=""`, and an empty submit is skipped so the old value is kept |
| `warranty_password` (real-garant) | no hint — the ciphertext *is* echoed into the box (disabled while set), and after "Reset password" an empty submit **deletes** the row, so "leave empty to keep" would be wrong |
| `api_key` (remove-bg) | no hint — plaintext and echoed back, so the box is not empty |
| `nederlandMobiel_api_key` | no hint — plaintext, echoed back, and an empty submit **wipes** it |
| `vwe_username`, `vwe_message_type` | no hint — plaintext, echoed back, empty wipes |
| website, ai, support | no secret fields (support has no inputs at all) |

The hint uses the existing `help` slot on `x-ui.field` (`.ui-field-help` already exists). It reflects only whether a settings row exists — never the value, never its length, no masked characters — and the boolean is computed in the controller, because `vwe_password` is a platform row that `$settings` does not carry for a dealer without the `removebgkey` right. Verified both wordings render and that the stored value appears nowhere in the HTML.

### The thumbnail bottom-right of Shane's screenshot

Not from this page, and not removed. It is the **LYRA chatbot toggle** in the shared layout (`resources/views/chatbot/index.blade.php:100`): a fixed 50x50 round button at `bottom: 1.5rem; right: 1.5rem`, included on every authenticated page via `@if(Access::showChat())` — which is true for any `BEHEERDER` even when the chatbot is disabled. Its glyph is a Font Awesome `fa fa-comments`, so it reads as a small blank tile if the icon font has not loaded. On a narrow window the anomaly bell (`.anomaly-btn`) stacks just above it. Nothing in `transport.blade.php` renders anything floating.

## Screenshots

Rendered through the test kernel with a fixture admin and seeded prices, dimensions, locations, key and backgrounds.

- `transport-{before,after}-{1280,390}.png`
- `achtergrond-{before,after}-{1280,390}.png`
- `vwe-{before,after}-{1280,390}.png`

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` + `php -l` on every compiled view: clean.
- `npm run build`: clean. `public/build` is untracked and not committed.
- Full suite: **415 tests, 1732 assertions, 2 failures** — `BuildStampTest` and `RemoveBackgroundTest`, both of which fail identically on unmodified `origin/main` in this local environment (build stamp and an outbound fixture); everything else green. The targeted set (`SmokeTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `UiApiUsageTest`, `ClassReferencesResolveTest`, `Transport*`, `BuildContractTest`, `RowActionsOwnershipTest`, `ViewLogicHelpersTest`) is 146 tests, all passing — including the check that every `ui-` class in refresh.css is used and every `ui-` class in a view is defined.
- Grepped every id/class on both panes before touching them: `search-transport`, `setting-website-form`, `setting-update-form`, `price_input`, `transport_marge`/`transport_express_price`/`transport_electronic_car`, `transport[<price_id>]`, `background_image` / `background_image_<id>` / `remove_button` / `remove_image`, `location.create|edit|destroy` with `is_pick_up` / `is_delivery`. All unchanged.
- Address CRUD still goes through its own routes and modals; the transport form still posts the same fields to the same route.
- New translations in all languages that carry the surrounding keys: `transport.add_address`, `transport.settings` (nl/en/fr/de/es) and `dealer.vwe_password_set` / `dealer.vwe_password_unset` (nl/en/fr/de — `es/dealer.php` carries no `vwe_*` keys and falls back, so none were added there).
params.title: Settings: one layout for the transport sections, the backgrounds pane and the VWE secret hint
